item.title: Bumble Lets Either Match Partner Send First Message
item.description: Bumble drops the women‑first rule, letting any match start a chat with a 72‑hour reply window, AI nudges and broader gender options reshaping dating.

item.title: Bumble Lets Anyone Message First, Extends Reply Window
item.description: Bumble drops its women‑first rule for heterosexual matches, allowing any user to start a chat and expanding the response time to 72 hours globally.
